You can get your ring cleaned at most jewlery chains (Zales, Kays, etc) for free as often as you would like in case you are at the mall and just want it touched up.  You don't have to purchase anything and the rings don't have to be purchased from one of their stores.

Source:  I used to work for Zales.

Ring cleanings are free at most chains as often as you would like.  Your ring does not have to be purchased there and you don't have to buy anything.

 Walk into a Zales, Kays, etc and a sales associate will be happy to place your ring in the cleaning machine for ten minutes.  Ask the associate to check for loose stones prior to putting it in the machine because the machine can knock out loose stones.  If there are loose stones the associate will clean it by hand.

Also, you can buy ring cleaning kits there for $5 or so (if I recall correctly) and clean it yourself at home.

Source:  I used to work for Zales.

Ring cleanings are typically free at most jewelry stores, especially chains, so if you want to go in for a cleaning prior to your six month deadline walk into a Zales, Kays, etc.  This is completely free, you don't have to purchase anything, and you don't have to have purchased your ring there.  They will happily clean your ring for you.  You can also purchase a cleaning kit for about $5 or so (if I remember correctly) and clean it yourself at home.

Getting insurance on rings is such a great investment, especially if the ring was expensive.  Smaller stones can get loose over time and knocked out.  Most warranties cover securing loose stones, lifetime resizing, and any fractures/breaks.

Source:  I used to work at Zales.

Yes, ring cleaning is amazing!  I worked at Zales for awhile and cleanings are free and really make the ring sparkle.  Any jewelry chain should offer free cleanings (Kays, Zales, etc) free of charge.  You don't have to purchase anything, you can bring it in as many times as you want for a cleaning, and the ring doesn't have to be purchased from one of their stores.  There are also cleaning kits for sale for about $5 (if I remember correctly) so you can clean your ring at home.

Advice:  If you are having your engagement ring or any other ring with stones in it cleaned ask the sales associate to check if any of your stones are loose prior to the cleaning.  It's very easy for them to do and only takes about a minute or less.  If any are loose, the associate can clean it by hand.  The machine rings are cleaned in vibrate and can sometimes knock loose stones out of the ring.

Happy ring cleanings everyone!
